reasons.persona_fit: Directly speaks to an owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice; respects all boundaries including human approval and the strict no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: Logical flow from picking one recurring workflow to writing the decision rule and applying a simple three-part filter; explanations are plain and lucid.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic, concrete diagnostic filter and next step for an owner before touching software tools, correctly noting when not to automate.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes zero unsupported capability, customer, or metric claims; explicitly maintains mandatory human approval for money movement and high-risk steps.
